ValidationRule.description: A quote is required before an Opportunity can be moved to the "Propose" or "Contract" Stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Number_of_Quotes__c = 0, ISCHANGED( StageName ), NOT(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'SAS')), OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Propose' ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Contract' )), NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRules ), NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Quote" is required before this Opportunity can be moved to the "Propose" or "Contract" Stage
